strategies.text: Chase the imp through the library, he teleports and casts Fireblast; stay on him and kill the dogs around.
Hits the group with area damage; one tank hold, healer stay behind a pillar.
Splits into water elementals; kill them first.
Caster boss, interrupt where possible and kill Pimgib quickly.
Shapeshifts between forms and fears; kill adds and keep the tank alive in wolf form.
